The luxurious train is surprisingly full for the time of the year but, by the morning, it is one passenger fewer. An American tycoon lies dead in his compartment, stabbed a dozen times, his door locked from the inside.

One of the passengers is none other than detective Hercule Poirot. On vacation.

Isolated and with a killer on board, Poirot must identify the murderer—in case he or she decides to strike again.
properties.short_description: Detective Poirot solves a murder on a snowbound train, uncovering a web of past crimes and justice.

Normal People (2001), directed by Oleg Novkovic and starring Nebojsa Glogovac, Ljubinka Klaric and Ivan Jevtovic, is a Serbian-language drama produced in the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. Set in the suburbs of Belgrade, it portrays a group of friends trapped in a ghetto marked by post‑war malaise, where hopelessness, loneliness and frequent violence erode personal ambitions and relationships. Rooted in social realism and shot in color with a raw, claustrophobic style, the film explores post‑war trauma, alienation and the bleak emotional landscape of a disillusioned generation.

Pride & Prejudice (2005), directed by Joe Wright and starring Keira Knightley, Matthew Macfadyen, and Brenda Blethyn, is a romantic period drama adapted from the classic novel. Set in late 18th-century English society, it follows a sharp-witted young woman whose initial dislike of a proud gentleman gradually gives way to understanding and love. The film foregrounds character-driven emotion, social manners, and questions of class and marriage, rendered in a lyrical, naturalistic visual style. Its tone is intimate and heartfelt, balancing wit with wistful romantic longing.

Pride and Prejudice (1995) is a BBC television adaptation of Jane Austen’s novel directed by Simon Langton and adapted by Andrew Davies, starring Jennifer Ehle and Colin Firth alongside Susannah Harker. The six-part period drama combines faithful dialogue and extended scenes to explore courtship, class, and family in Regency England. Noted for its lush locations, authentic costumes, and a memorable score, the series balances sharp social comedy with heartfelt romantic development. Its measured pacing and character-focused storytelling emphasize themes of pride, prejudice, and personal growth.

Cast Away (2000), directed by Robert Zemeckis and starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt, is an adventure-drama with romantic elements about a FedEx systems analyst who survives a plane crash and is stranded on a remote island. The film blends survival set pieces with intimate character study to examine isolation, loss, resilience, and the importance of human connection, and its tone is meditative and poignant.

Through deliberate, painterly compositions and a slow-burning narrative, it investigates desire, the power of the gaze, and how memory and social constraint shape attachment. The result is a visually sumptuous, emotionally resonant work that lingers on...

short_descriptions.value: On a remote Breton island in the late 18th century, a painter commissioned for a wedding portrait and her subject develop a secret, intense romance.

properties.description: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot (2018), directed by Gus Van Sant and starring Joaquin Phoenix, Jonah Hill and Rooney Mara, is a biographical comedy-drama about the cartoonist John Callahan. After a crippling accident he struggles with alcoholism, finds support in a recovery group, and channels his voice into provocative cartoons that reshape his life. The film balances blunt honesty about addiction with dark humor and a compassionate focus on personal growth and forgiveness.

short_descriptions.value: After a paralyzing accident, a man battles addiction and finds renewed purpose and forgiveness by creating provocative, healing cartoons.
Nach einem verheerenden Unfall kämpft ein Mann gegen Sucht und findet durch provokante Cartoons neuen Lebenssinn und Selbstvergebung.
Tras un accidente que lo paraliza, un hombre lucha contra la adicción y halla propósito y perdón creando caricaturas provocadoras que le sanan.

properties.description: The Gray Man (2022), directed by Anthony Russo and Joe Russo and starring Ryan Gosling, Chris Evans, and Ana de Armas, is an action-mystery-thriller about a covert CIA operative who uncovers dark agency secrets and becomes the target of a ruthless former colleague. The film stages globe-trotting, stunt-heavy set pieces and a breathless cat-and-mouse narrative that foregrounds spectacle and suspense. Themes include betrayal, identity, and institutional corruption, and the overall tone is tense and adrenaline-driven.

short_descriptions.value: A covert CIA operative who uncovers agency secrets is targeted by a psychopathic ex-colleague who places a bounty on him, triggering a global manhunt.

Un operativo encubierto de la CIA que descubre secretos de la agencia se convierte en objetivo de un excolega psicópata que pone precio a su cabeza, desencadenando una caza global.

properties.description: The Stronghold (original title BAC Nord) is a 2020 crime thriller directed by Cédric Jimenez and starring Gilles Lellouche, Karim Leklou and François Civil. The film follows a police brigade operating in Marseille's most dangerous northern neighborhoods as they confront drug trafficking, violent organized crime and the systemic barriers that complicate their work. Rooted in real events, it emphasizes gritty, realistic depictions of street policing, intense action sequences and morally fraught choices. The result is a tense, uncompromising drama about duty, loyalty and institutional failure.

short_descriptions.value: A police brigade in Marseille battles drug gangs and institutional corruption, risking everything to restore order.

Themes include artistic genius, mental illness, isolation, and the sustaining yet fraught relationships with peers and his brother. It follows two dedicated educators who run an independent program rescuing and supporting autistic children and adolescents overlooked by conventional institutions. properties.description: Sink or Swim (Le Grand Bain) is a 2018 French comedy-drama directed by Gilles Lellouche and starring Mathieu Amalric, Guillaume Canet, and Benoît Poelvoorde. The film follows a depressed man who joins a group of middle‑aged men forming a male synchronized swimming team; through their absurd rehearsals and public performances they discover friendship, self‑respect, and renewed purpose. Mixing broad humor with tender, melancholic moments, the ensemble piece explores themes of masculinity, midlife crisis, and personal reinvention while maintaining a warm, uplifting tone.

properties.description: Marie Antoinette (released 2023) is a biographical period drama that chronicles the famed queen's experience at the French court. Starring Emilia Schüle, Louis Cunningham, and Jack Archer, the series combines sumptuous production design and costume work with a character-driven, empathetic retelling of a young woman's struggle under dynastic pressure. The series explores themes of identity, desire, aging, loneliness and the transactional nature of intimacy, balancing erotic and comedic moments with elegiac, emotionally layered storytelling.

properties.description: Lastman (released 2016) is an adult French-language animated series that blends action, crime drama, supernatural horror, and dark comedy. It follows boxer Richard Aldana as he becomes the guardian of Siri, an orphan pursued by monstrous superhumans, and navigates a corrupt urban underworld. Through intimate, dialogue-driven episodes set around the November 2015 terror attacks, the show examines trauma, guilt and the ethical complexities of psychotherapy. properties.description: Long Shot (2019), directed by Jonathan Levine and starring Charlize Theron and Seth Rogen, is a romantic comedy with a political satirical bent. It follows a freelance journalist who reunites with his childhood crush—now an influential political figure—and is hired as her speechwriter during a presidential campaign. The film mines both raunchy and heartfelt comedy to explore class differences, public image, and the tension between career ambition and personal life. properties.description: Shoplifters (2018), directed by Hirokazu Koreeda and starring Lily Franky, Sakura Andô and Kirin Kiki, is a Japanese drama with crime elements about a poverty-stricken, makeshift family who survive through petty theft and mutual care. After they take in a neglected little girl, their household briefly opens to warmth before an arrest exposes secrets and moral compromises. The film explores themes of family, poverty, survival and moral ambiguity with a tender, melancholic tone and an intimate, realist visual style.

short_descriptions.value: A makeshift family survives by petty theft and informal adoption until an arrest exposes long-hidden secrets and moral compromises.
Eine improvisierte Familie überlebt mit kleinen Diebstählen und heimlichen Adoptionen, bis die Verhaftung eines Kindes ihre Geheimnisse offenlegt.
Una familia improvisada sobrevive con pequeños robos y adopciones informales hasta que el arresto de un niño destapa secretos que lo cambian todo.
Une famille de fortune vit de petits larcins et d'adoptions informelles; l'arrestation d'un enfant révèle des secrets qui bouleversent leur vie.

properties.description: Mirai (2018), directed by Mamoru Hosoda and starring English-dub voices including Daniel Dae Kim, Rebecca Hall, and John Cho, is an animated family fantasy-drama. The film follows a young boy whose resentment of a newborn sister leads him to a mysterious garden where he can travel through time and meet relatives from different eras. Balancing playful, imaginative sequences with close domestic observation, it examines jealousy, memory, and the slow work of growing up. The result is a tender, emotionally rich portrait of family and perspective.

short_descriptions.value: A young boy finds a magical garden that lets him travel through time to meet relatives and learn to accept his new baby sister.
Ein Junge entdeckt einen magischen Garten, der ihm Zeitreisen ermöglicht, Verwandte trifft und ihn seine kleine Schwester akzeptieren lehrt.
Un niño descubre un jardín mágico que le permite viajar en el tiempo para conocer a sus familiares y aprender a aceptar a su hermana bebé.
Un garçon découvre un jardin magique qui lui permet de voyager dans le temps, rencontrer des proches et apprendre à accepter sa petite sœur.

entities.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

properties.description: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas (2018) is a Japanese animated coming-of-age drama directed by Shin'ichiro Ushijima, adapted from the novel by Yoru Sumino and featuring Mahiro Takasugi, Lynn, and Yukiyo Fujii. The film follows an introverted high-school student who discovers a classmate's private diary and learns she is secretly terminally ill, prompting an emotionally charged friendship. Blending quiet humor, romance, and melancholy, the movie examines mortality, memory, and the transformative power of human connection. Its tone is tender and bittersweet, guided by lyrical animation and intimat...

short_descriptions.value: An introverted student forms a deep bond with a vivacious classmate who is secretly terminally ill, and together they confront life, love, and loss.
Ein introvertierter Schüler verbindet sich mit einer lebensfrohen Klassenkameradin, die heimlich unheilbar krank ist; gemeinsam erleben sie Liebe, Leben und Verlust.
Un estudiante introvertido crea un vínculo profundo con una compañera vivaz que está terminalmente enferma, y juntos afrontan la vida, el amor y la pérdida.
Un lycéen introverti se lie à une camarade pleine de vie atteinte d'une maladie terminale, et ensemble ils affrontent la vie, l'amour et la perte.

properties.description: Isle of Dogs (2018), directed by Wes Anderson, is a stop-motion animated adventure-comedy set in a near-future Japan with a voice cast that includes Bryan Cranston, Koyu Rankin, and Edward Norton. The film follows a young boy who travels to a quarantined "Trash Island" to rescue his exiled dog, blending whimsical visuals with sharp political satire and emotional depth. Stylistically it relies on handcrafted miniatures, precise tableaux, and Anderson's signature symmetry to produce a tactile, painterly world. Thematically it examines loyalty, exile, and the abuse of power while balancing dea...

short_descriptions.value: A boy travels to a quarantined island to rescue his exiled dog amid a canine epidemic and a corrupt mayor's crackdown.
Ein Junge reist zu einer unter Quarantäne stehenden Insel, um seinen verbannten Hund während einer Hundeepidemie und der Schikane eines korrupten Bürgermeisters zu retten.
Un niño viaja a una isla en cuarentena para rescatar a su perro exiliado en plena epidemia canina y frente a la represión de un alcalde corrupto.
Un garçon brave une île en quarantaine pour retrouver son chien exilé au cœur d'une épidémie canine et de la répression d'un maire corrompu.

properties.description: A Whisker Away (2020), directed by Junichi Sato and Tomotaka Shibayama and produced by Studio Colorido, is an animated fantasy romance that follows a shy schoolgirl who uses a magical mask to transform into a cat to get closer to her crush. Featuring voices by Mirai Shida, Natsuki Hanae, and Minako Kotobuki, the film balances whimsical fantasy with intimate coming-of-age drama as it examines identity, family tensions, and the consequences of hiding one’s true self. The emotional, melodic score and richly textured visuals reinforce a bittersweet yet ultimately hopeful tone.

short_descriptions.value: A shy girl uses a magical mask to become a cat and get close to her crush, but the line between her human self and the feline identity blurs with emotional consequences.
Ein schüchternes Mädchen trägt eine magische Maske, um sich in eine Katze zu verwandeln und ihrem Schwarm näherzukommen, doch die Grenze zwischen Mensch und Tier verwischt mit emotionalen Folgen.
Una chica tímida usa una máscara mágica para convertirse en gato y acercarse a su amor, pero la frontera entre su yo humano y el gato se difumina con consecuencias emocionales.
Une adolescente timide porte un masque magique pour devenir chat et se rapprocher de son amour, mais la frontière entre son identité humaine et féline s’estompe avec des répercussions émotionnelles.

akas.value: "Ride Your Wave: Juntos en el mar"

properties.description: Ride Your Wave is a 2019 Japanese animated film directed by Masaaki Yuasa and featuring Ryôta Katayose, Rina Kawaei, and Honoka Matsumoto. Blending romance, comedy, drama, family-friendly moments, and light fantasy, it follows a surfer and a firefighter who fall in love and then face a devastating loss. The movie uses vivid, stylized animation and music to trace the heroine's grieving and healing, exploring themes of love, memory, and coping. Its tone is bittersweet and emotionally resonant, balancing heartwarming intimacy with heartrending tragedy.

short_descriptions.value: A surfer and a firefighter fall in love, then face a tragic separation that forces her to cope with loss while holding onto shared memories.
Eine Surferin und ein Feuerwehrmann verlieben sich; nach einer Tragödie muss sie mit dem Verlust umgehen und an ihren gemeinsamen Erinnerungen festhalten.
Una surfista y un bombero se enamoran; tras una tragedia ella debe afrontar la pérdida mientras se aferra a sus recuerdos compartidos.
Une surfeuse et un pompier tombent amoureux; après une tragédie, elle doit affronter la perte en s'accrochant à leurs souvenirs communs.

properties.description: Asako I & II (2018), directed by Ryûsuke Hamaguchi and starring Masahiro Higashide, Erika Karata and Sairi Itô, is a literary adaptation and romantic drama that follows a shy Osaka woman torn between a vanished, free-spirited lover and his lookalike with a steady life in Tokyo. The narrative is a slow-burning character study of memory, obsession and the tension between ecstatic passion and dependable affection, with pivotal moments played out against everyday detail and a real-world earthquake. Tonally melancholic and tender, the film favors composed, atmospheric imagery and subtle emotiona...

short_descriptions.value: A woman falls for a charismatic stranger who disappears, then meets his lookalike with a different personality and must choose between obsession and stability.
Eine Frau verliebt sich in einen charismatischen Mann, der verschwindet; Jahre später trifft sie dessen Doppelgänger mit anderem Wesen und muss zwischen Obsession und Stabilität wählen.
Una mujer se enamora de un hombre carismático que desaparece; años después conoce a su doble con otra personalidad y debe elegir entre obsesión y estabilidad.
Une femme tombe pour un homme charismatique qui disparaît ; des années plus tard elle rencontre son sosie au caractère opposé et doit choisir entre obsession et stabilité.

properties.description: We Are Little Zombies (2019) is directed by Makoto Nagahisa and stars Keita Ninomiya, Mondo Okumura, and Satoshi Mizuno. The film follows four orphaned children who meet in a funeral home, remain oddly unmoved by their parents' deaths, and choose to live together, forming a makeshift family. Marked by highly stylized, colorful visuals and frequent video‑game references, the movie combines dark comedy and music-infused drama to explore grief, emotional numbness, and the search for identity. Critics have praised its original aesthetic, sound design, and daring directorial voice.

short_descriptions.value: Four orphaned children meet at a funeral home, feel strangely numb about their parents' deaths, and decide to live together as a makeshift family.
Vier Waisenkinder treffen sich in einem Bestattungshaus, sind seltsam unberührt vom Tod ihrer Eltern und beschließen, zusammenzuleben und eine provisorische Familie zu bilden.
Cuatro niños huérfanos se encuentran en una funeraria, no sienten pena por la muerte de sus padres y deciden formar una familia improvisada viviendo juntos.
Quatre enfants orphelins se rencontrent dans une morgue, restent étrangement indifférents au décès de leurs parents et décident de vivre ensemble comme une famille improvisée.

akas.value: "Weathering with You – Das Mädchen, das die Sonne berührte"

properties.description: Weathering with You (2019/2020) is a Japanese animated romantic fantasy drama written and directed by Makoto Shinkai and starring Kotaro Daigo, Nana Mori, and Tsubasa Honda. The film follows a runaway teen who arrives in a perpetually rainy Tokyo and befriends an orphaned girl with the supernatural ability to clear the skies; their growing romance and small business offering sunshine draw moral dilemmas and escalating consequences. Visually sumptuous and richly textured, the movie juxtaposes intimate character drama with grand, rain-drenched spectacle while exploring themes of love, sacrifi...

short_descriptions.value: A runaway teen in rain-soaked Tokyo befriends an orphan girl who can clear the skies, and their risky romance forces them to confront fate, responsibility, and sacrifice.
Ein weggelaufener Teenager in einem regendurchtränkten Tokio trifft ein Waisenkind, das den Himmel klären kann; ihre riskante Beziehung stellt sie vor Schicksal, Verantwortung und Opfer.
Un adolescente fugado en un Tokio empapado conoce a una huérfana que puede hacer brillar el sol, y su arriesgada relación les obliga a afrontar destino, responsabilidad y sacrificio.
Un adolescent fugueur arrive dans un Tokyo sans cesse arrosé et rencontre une orpheline capable d'apaiser le ciel; leur romance risquée les confronte au destin et au sacrifice.

properties.description: Theater (2020), directed by Isao Yukisada and starring Kento Yamazaki, Mayu Matsuoka, and Kan'ichirô Satô, is a Japanese-language drama-romance about a theater troupe director whose financial and personal failures strain his relationships and artistic ambitions. The film traces his swings between grand ambition and crippling insecurity, the emotional harm inflicted on those around him, and the fragile hope that remains. Visually restrained and naturalistic, the movie emphasizes intimate performances and the moral complexity of its characters. Its themes include artistic struggle, the costs ...

short_descriptions.value: A struggling theatre director battles insecurity and ego as his failing troupe and fraught love life force him to confront the consequences of his ambition.
Ein kämpfender Theaterregisseur ringt mit Unsicherheit und Ego, während seine Truppe und Beziehung zerbrechen und er sich den Folgen seiner Ambitionen stellen muss.
Un director de teatro en apuros lidia con inseguridad y ego mientras su troupe y su relación se resquebrajan, obligándole a enfrentar las consecuencias de su ambición.
Un metteur en scène en difficulté lutte avec son ego et son manque de confiance alors que sa troupe et sa relation se détériorent, l'obligeant à affronter les conséquences de son ambition.

properties.description: Burning (2018), directed by Lee Chang-dong and starring Yoo Ah-in, Steven Yeun, and Jeon Jong-seo, is a slow-burning drama-thriller adapted from a Murakami short story. It follows an aspiring writer whose reunion with a childhood acquaintance and a charismatic outsider spirals into obsession and a troubling disappearance. The film uses restrained, painterly visuals and patient pacing to probe class inequality, alienation, and the instability of perception. The result is brooding, ambiguous, and invites multiple interpretations.

short_descriptions.value: A young man becomes obsessed after a childhood acquaintance returns with a mysterious, wealthy stranger whose secret hobby links to a puzzling disappearance.
Ein junger Mann wird besessen, als eine Jugendbekannte mit einem rätselhaften, wohlhabenden Fremden zurückkehrt, dessen geheimes Hobby mit einer mysteriösen Vermisstenangelegenheit verbunden ist.
Un joven se obsesiona cuando una conocida de la infancia vuelve con un misterioso y adinerado desconocido cuyo secreto se vincula a una enigmática desaparición.
Un jeune homme s'obsède lorsqu'une amie d'enfance revient avec un mystérieux homme riche dont le loisir secret se lie à une disparition énigmatique.

entities.name: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop

akas.value: "サイダーのように言葉が湧き上がる"

properties.description: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop (2021) is a Japanese animated romantic drama directed by Kyôhei Ishiguro and featuring performances by Somegorô Ichikawa, Hana Sugisaki, and Megumi Han. The story follows a shy young man who writes haiku and a masked social-media creator who connect after accidentally swapping phones, then grow closer while working at an elderly care center and bonding over music. Combining vivid, summery visuals and a prominent musical soundtrack, the film examines communication, insecurity, and self-acceptance through quiet, character-driven moments and bittersweet warmth.

short_descriptions.value: A shy teen who writes haiku and a masked online creator meet after swapping phones and form a tender, music-filled romance that helps them face insecurity and connect.

Ein schüchterner Teenager, der Haikus schreibt, und eine maskierte Online‑Künstlerin tauschen zufällig Telefone und beginnen eine zarte, musikdurchdrungene Romanze, die ihnen hilft, ihre Unsicherheiten zu überwinden.
Un joven tímido que escribe haikus y una creadora enmascarada se conocen tras intercambiar teléfonos y entablan un tierno romance musical que les ayuda a superar inseguridades.
Un jeune timide adepte du haïku et une créatrice masquée se rencontrent après avoir échangé leurs téléphones et entament une romance musicale qui les aide à surmonter leurs insécurités.

signal.name: Tokyo
signal.disambiguation: 東京都

properties.description: Carole & Tuesday (2019) is an anime series supervised by Shinichiro Watanabe that blends drama, music, and science fiction. Starring Miyuri Shimabukuro, Kana Ichinose, and Akio Ôtsuka, it follows two young women from different social backgrounds who form a songwriting duo and rise through a music scene dominated by AI. The series pairs heartfelt, character-driven storytelling with vivid, performance-focused animation and explores themes of creativity, identity, class, and technological influence on art. Its emotional tone is warm and inspiring, with moments of melancholy and social commentary.

short_descriptions.value: Two aspiring musicians from different backgrounds form a duo and challenge an AI-driven music industry with their songs.
Zwei Musikerinnen aus unterschiedlichen Milieus bilden ein Duo und stellen mit ihren Songs eine von KI dominierte Musikindustrie infrage.
Dos aspirantes a músicas de distintos orígenes forman un dúo y desafían una industria musical dominada por IA con sus canciones.
Deux musiciennes issues de milieux opposés s'unissent en duo pour défier l'industrie musicale dominée par l'IA avec leurs chansons.

entities.name: The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House

akas.value: "舞妓さんちのまかないさん"
"The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House"

properties.description: The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House (2023) is a Japanese web comedy-drama starring Nana Mori, Natsuki Deguchi, and Ai Hashimoto that follows two young women who move to Kyoto to train as maiko and the domestic world they inhabit. Rather than relying on plot twists, the series focuses on quiet, character-driven vignettes—training, mentorship, and the meals prepared by the house's makanai—to explore tradition, identity, and friendship. Visually rich and gently paced, the show celebrates food, cultural ritual, and everyday intimacy to produce a soothing, emotionally resonant experience.

short_descriptions.value: Two friends move to Kyoto to train as maiko but take different paths while sharing life, work, and food in a maiko house.
Zwei Freundinnen ziehen nach Kyoto, um Maiko zu werden, doch gehen unterschiedliche Wege, während sie Leben und Küche in einem Maiko-Haus teilen.
Dos amigas se mudan a Kioto para formarse como maiko, pero toman caminos distintos mientras comparten vida y comida en la casa de maiko.
Deux amies viennent à Kyoto pour devenir maiko, mais suivent des voies différentes tout en partageant la vie et la cuisine d'une maison de maiko.

properties.description: Aggretsuko (2018) centers on a 25-year-old red panda office worker who copes with a thankless corporate job by unleashing death‑metal karaoke after hours. Featuring Sanrio character designs and a mix of comedy, drama, and musical interludes, the series balances workplace satire with character-driven emotional arcs. Main cast credits listed include Kaolip, Shingo Kato, and Rareko, and the show repeatedly addresses themes such as workplace stress, sexism, mental health, friendship, and self‑expression. Its emotional register shifts between cathartic rage and bittersweet empathy while remainin...

short_descriptions.value: A 25-year-old red panda office worker vents workplace frustration by singing death-metal karaoke after work.
Eine 25-jährige rote Panda-Büroangestellte baut ihren Frust durch Death‑Metal-Karaoke nach der Arbeit ab.
Una panda roja de 25 años, agobiada por su trabajo de oficina, libera su frustración cantando death metal en el karaoke.
Une panda rouge de 25 ans, épuisée par son travail de bureau, évacue sa frustration en chantant du death metal au karaoké.

properties.description: Gintama (2005) is a long-running Japanese animated series based on Hideaki Sorachi’s manga, produced by Sunrise and directed in early seasons by Shinji Takamatsu (with Yoichi Fujita and others directing later installments). Starring voice actors Tomokazu Sugita, Daisuke Sakaguchi, and Rie Kugimiya among its principal cast, the show combines science-fiction and samurai tropes: Edo-era Japan is occupied by alien beings, and the story follows a lazy but skilled samurai who runs a small odd-jobs business and his eccentric partners. Equal parts slapstick comedy, pop-culture parody, action, and u...

short_descriptions.value: In an alternate-feudal Tokyo occupied by aliens, an unemployed samurai takes odd jobs with his quirky team, blending slapstick comedy, action, parody, and occasional sincere drama.
In einem von Außerirdischen besetzten feudalen Tokio nimmt ein arbeitsloser Samurai Aufträge mit seinem skurrilen Team an und mixt Komödie, Action, Parodie und Gefühl.
En un Tokio feudal ocupado por extraterrestres, un samurái desempleado acepta encargos con su peculiar equipo, mezclando comedia slapstick, acción, parodia y momentos emotivos.
Dans un Tokyo féodal occupé par des extraterrestres, un samouraï sans emploi accepte des petits boulots avec son équipe décalée, mêlant comédie, action et émotion.

properties.description: Food Wars: Shokugeki no Soma is a competitive culinary anime that follows a talented young cook who enrolls in an elite culinary academy to refine his skills and outcook his father. Blending high-energy comedy, exaggerated visualizations of taste, and earnest depictions of technique, the series stages elaborate cook-offs—shokugeki—that serve as trials testing creativity, skill, and resolve. Rooted in themes of ambition, mentorship, tradition versus innovation, and the social power of food, the narrative evolves from classroom challenges to large-scale tournaments while maintaining a tone th...

short_descriptions.value: A young cook enrolls in an elite culinary academy where intense cooking duels push him to master his craft and surpass his father's skills.
Ein junger Koch tritt in eine Elite-Kochschule ein, wo intensive Kochduelle ihn treiben, sein Handwerk zu meistern und seinen Vater zu übertreffen.
Un joven cocinero entra en una prestigiosa academia culinaria donde duelos gastronómicos lo empujan a dominar su oficio y superar a su padre.
Un jeune cuisinier rejoint une académie culinaire d'élite où des duels gastronomiques le poussent à maîtriser son art et dépasser son père.

entities.name: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke

properties.description: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke (2023) is a live-action adaptation of the beloved shojo property that stars Kou Aoki, Sara Minami, and Oji Suzuka in a gentle romantic comedy-drama. The story centers on a shy, misunderstood high-school girl whose life changes when an outgoing classmate befriends her, leading to new friendships and first love. Across its episodes the show emphasizes character-driven, coming-of-age themes—identity, social acceptance, and emotional growth—delivered with a sentimental, nostalgic tone and visually polished direction.

short_descriptions.value: A shy, misunderstood teen opens up when a kind classmate reaches out, leading to friendship and her first love.
Ein schüchternes, missverstandenes Mädchen öffnet sich, als ein freundlicher Mitschüler auf sie zugeht, was Freundschaft und erste Liebe entstehen lässt.
Una chica tímida y malentendida sale de su caparazón cuando un compañero amable se acerca, dando paso a la amistad y al primer amor.
Une adolescente timide et incomprise s’ouvre peu à peu grâce à un camarade bienveillant, et découvre l’amitié puis son premier amour.

akas.value: "Yahari ore no seishun love kome wa machigatteiru"
"やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。"

properties.description: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU (original Japanese title Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru) is a 2013 animated drama/romantic comedy adapted from Wataru Watari's light novels. The first season, directed by Ai Yoshimura and produced as a TV anime, follows an acerbic, isolated high-school student compelled to join his school's Volunteer Service Club alongside two classmates. The series mixes pointed, often humorous dialogue with quieter, melancholic character work as the trio solves peers' social problems and — in the process — confronts their own emotional defenses. Themes inc...

short_descriptions.value: A cynical, solitary high-schooler is forced into a volunteer club where solving classmates' problems forces him to confront isolation, honesty, and complicated feelings.
Ein zynischer, zurückgezogener Gymnasiast tritt einem Freiwilligenclub bei und muss beim Lösen von Mitschülerproblemen seine Isolation und Gefühle hinterfragen.
Un estudiante solitario y cínico se ve obligado a entrar en un club de voluntariado; al resolver los problemas de sus compañeros, afronta su aislamiento y sentimientos complejos.
Un lycéen cynique et solitaire rejoint un club bénévole ; en aidant ses camarades, il confronte son isolement, la sincérité et des sentiments compliqués.

properties.description: Spy x Family (2022) is an animated action-comedy series that follows a master spy who creates a fake family as part of a cover; the household unexpectedly includes an assassin wife and a telepathic child. The show balances dynamic espionage set-pieces with slice-of-life family comedy, exploring themes of secrecy, identity, and belonging while maintaining a warm, humorous tone. Voice performers listed include Takuya Eguchi, Atsumi Tanezaki, and Alex Organ. Its blend of character-driven warmth and action-oriented pacing gives it broad appeal across family-friendly and anime-focused audiences.

short_descriptions.value: A spy, an assassin, and a telepathic child pose as a family to conceal their secrets while juggling missions, school, and unexpectedly growing affection.
Ein Spion, eine Attentäterin und ein telepathisches Kind geben eine falsche Familie, um ihre Geheimnisse zu verbergen, und meistern Missionen, Schule und wachsende Zuneigung.
Un espía, una asesina y una niña telepática forman una familia falsa para ocultar sus secretos mientras enfrentan misiones, el colegio y el cariño que surge entre ellos.
Un espion, une tueuse à gages et une enfant télépathe forment une famille factice pour cacher leurs secrets tout en gérant missions, école et l'affection naissante.

tags.name: Chainsaw as instrument of violence and renewal

properties.description: Chainsaw Man (2022) is an adult-oriented animated adaptation of a popular manga that blends dark fantasy, brutal action, and black comedy. Produced by MAPPA and based on the manga by Tatsuki Fujimoto, the series follows a desperate young man who is resurrected when his pet devil fuses with him, turning him into a chainsaw-wielding devil-human hybrid. Recruited into a government-aligned devil-hunting agency, he partners with other misfit hunters and becomes entangled with a manipulative superior while confronting grotesque devils and moral compromises. The show is notable for its stark contr...

short_descriptions.value: A betrayed young man fuses with his pet devil to become a chainsaw-powered hybrid and joins a devil-hunting agency, confronting violence, manipulation, and his own desires.
Nach einem Verrat verschmilzt ein junger Mann mit seinem Haustier-Teufel und wird zum Kettensägen-Hybrid, der sich einer Teufelsjäger-Organisation anschließt.
Tras una traición, un joven se fusiona con su diablo mascota y se convierte en un híbrido motosierrado; se une a cazadores de demonios y afronta violencia y manipulación.
Après une trahison, un jeune homme fusionne avec son démon domestique et devient un hybride scie-mécanique, puis rejoint des chasseurs de démons entre violence et manipulation.

entities.name: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

akas.value: "この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！"
"Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!"

properties.description: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! is a 2016 anime adaptation of Natsume Akatsuki's light novel, directed by Takaomi Kanasaki and produced by Studio Deen. Starring Jun Fukushima, Sora Amamiya, Rie Takahashi, and Ai Kayano, the series blends comedy, fantasy, and adventure to subvert typical isekai and RPG conventions. After a young man dies and is offered rebirth in a magical realm by a self-described goddess, he forms a disastrously inept adventuring party and endures a string of absurd, episodic misadventures. The show emphasizes broad slapstick, satirical takes on heroism a...

short_descriptions.value: A dead otaku is reincarnated in a fantasy world and joins a hapless adventuring party, leading to absurd misadventures that parody RPG and isekai tropes.
Ein wiedergeborener Otaku bildet in einer Fantasywelt eine Pannen-Truppe mit einer nutzlosen Göttin und zwei exzentrischen Gefährtinnen und erlebt komische Missgeschicke.
Un otaku reencarnado en un mundo fantástico forma un grupo con una inútil diosa y dos excéntricas, provocando desventuras cómicas que parodian los tropos RPG.
Un otaku réincarné dans un monde fantastique forme une équipe maladroite avec une déesse inutile et deux compagnes excentriques, entraînant des mésaventures comiques.

properties.description: Tomo-chan Is a Girl! (2023) is an animated romantic-comedy drama that follows a tomboyish high-school girl who has long been in love with her childhood friend but is seen only as "one of the guys." Starring Rie Takahashi, Kaito Ishikawa, and Rina Hidaka, the series adapts a gag-driven four-panel comic style into an episodic anime that balances broad physical humor with sincere character development. Over its run it explores themes of friendship, identity, and the awkward, slow-burning transition from friends to lovers, delivered with warm, uplifting emotional beats.

short_descriptions.value: A tomboy high-schooler confesses to her childhood friend and spends the series trying to get him to see her as more than a friend while navigating identity and friendship.
Eine tomboyhafte Gymnasiastin gesteht ihrem Freund aus Kindertagen und versucht, ihn dazu zu bringen, sie als mehr als eine Freundin zu sehen, während sie Freundschaft und Identität erkundet.
Una chica tomboy de instituto confiesa a su amigo de la infancia y pasa la serie intentando que la vea como algo más que una amiga mientras explora la amistad y su identidad.
Une lycéenne tomboy avoue ses sentiments à son ami d'enfance et tente durant la série de lui faire voir en elle plus qu'une amie, tout en explorant amitié et identité.

properties.description: Mob Psycho 100 is an animated series based on the manga by ONE and produced by studio Bones, directed by Yuzuru Tachikawa, with music contributions credited to MOB CHOIR. The show follows a shy middle-schooler with growing psychic powers who tries to live a normal life while working odd jobs under an unlikely mentor and confronting supernatural threats. properties.description: CHAI (stylized CHAI) are a four-piece all-female band from Nagoya, Japan, known for bright, rhythmic indie-pop/rock songs, funky grooves and a public focus on body positivity and self-acceptance. properties.description: Shoplifters (2018), directed by Hirokazu Koreeda and starring Lily Franky, Sakura Andô and Kirin Kiki, is a Japanese drama with crime elements about a poverty-stricken, makeshift family who survive through petty theft and mutual care. After they take in a neglected little girl, their household briefly opens to warmth before an arrest exposes secrets and moral compromises. The film explores themes of family, poverty, survival and moral ambiguity with a tender, melancholic tone and an intimate, realist visual style.

properties.description: Asako I & II (2018), directed by Ryûsuke Hamaguchi and starring Masahiro Higashide, Erika Karata and Sairi Itô, is a literary adaptation and romantic drama that follows a shy Osaka woman torn between a vanished, free-spirited lover and his lookalike with a steady life in Tokyo. The narrative is a slow-burning character study of memory, obsession and the tension between ecstatic passion and dependable affection, with pivotal moments played out against everyday detail and a real-world earthquake. Tonally melancholic and tender, the film favors composed, atmospheric imagery and subtle emotiona...

short_descriptions.value: A woman falls for a charismatic stranger who disappears, then meets his lookalike with a different personality and must choose between obsession and stability.
Eine Frau verliebt sich in einen charismatischen Mann, der verschwindet; Jahre später trifft sie dessen Doppelgänger mit anderem Wesen und muss zwischen Obsession und Stabilität wählen.
Una mujer se enamora de un hombre carismático que desaparece; años después conoce a su doble con otra personalidad y debe elegir entre obsesión y estabilidad.
Une femme tombe pour un homme charismatique qui disparaît ; des années plus tard elle rencontre son sosie au caractère opposé et doit choisir entre obsession et stabilité.

entities.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

properties.description: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas (2018) is a Japanese animated coming-of-age drama directed by Shin'ichiro Ushijima, adapted from the novel by Yoru Sumino and featuring Mahiro Takasugi, Lynn, and Yukiyo Fujii. The film follows an introverted high-school student who discovers a classmate's private diary and learns she is secretly terminally ill, prompting an emotionally charged friendship. Blending quiet humor, romance, and melancholy, the movie examines mortality, memory, and the transformative power of human connection. Its tone is tender and bittersweet, guided by lyrical animation and intimat...

short_descriptions.value: An introverted student forms a deep bond with a vivacious classmate who is secretly terminally ill, and together they confront life, love, and loss.
Ein introvertierter Schüler verbindet sich mit einer lebensfrohen Klassenkameradin, die heimlich unheilbar krank ist; gemeinsam erleben sie Liebe, Leben und Verlust.
Un estudiante introvertido crea un vínculo profundo con una compañera vivaz que está terminalmente enferma, y juntos afrontan la vida, el amor y la pérdida.
Un lycéen introverti se lie à une camarade pleine de vie atteinte d'une maladie terminale, et ensemble ils affrontent la vie, l'amour et la perte.

properties.description: We Are Little Zombies (2019) is directed by Makoto Nagahisa and stars Keita Ninomiya, Mondo Okumura, and Satoshi Mizuno. The film follows four orphaned children who meet in a funeral home, remain oddly unmoved by their parents' deaths, and choose to live together, forming a makeshift family. Marked by highly stylized, colorful visuals and frequent video‑game references, the movie combines dark comedy and music-infused drama to explore grief, emotional numbness, and the search for identity. Critics have praised its original aesthetic, sound design, and daring directorial voice.

short_descriptions.value: Four orphaned children meet at a funeral home, feel strangely numb about their parents' deaths, and decide to live together as a makeshift family.
Vier Waisenkinder treffen sich in einem Bestattungshaus, sind seltsam unberührt vom Tod ihrer Eltern und beschließen, zusammenzuleben und eine provisorische Familie zu bilden.
Cuatro niños huérfanos se encuentran en una funeraria, no sienten pena por la muerte de sus padres y deciden formar una familia improvisada viviendo juntos.
Quatre enfants orphelins se rencontrent dans une morgue, restent étrangement indifférents au décès de leurs parents et décident de vivre ensemble comme une famille improvisée.

properties.description: Mirai (2018), directed by Mamoru Hosoda and starring English-dub voices including Daniel Dae Kim, Rebecca Hall, and John Cho, is an animated family fantasy-drama. The film follows a young boy whose resentment of a newborn sister leads him to a mysterious garden where he can travel through time and meet relatives from different eras. Balancing playful, imaginative sequences with close domestic observation, it examines jealousy, memory, and the slow work of growing up. The result is a tender, emotionally rich portrait of family and perspective.

short_descriptions.value: A young boy finds a magical garden that lets him travel through time to meet relatives and learn to accept his new baby sister.
Ein Junge entdeckt einen magischen Garten, der ihm Zeitreisen ermöglicht, Verwandte trifft und ihn seine kleine Schwester akzeptieren lehrt.
Un niño descubre un jardín mágico que le permite viajar en el tiempo para conocer a sus familiares y aprender a aceptar a su hermana bebé.
Un garçon découvre un jardin magique qui lui permet de voyager dans le temps, rencontrer des proches et apprendre à accepter sa petite sœur.

akas.value: "Weathering with You – Das Mädchen, das die Sonne berührte"

properties.description: Weathering with You (2019/2020) is a Japanese animated romantic fantasy drama written and directed by Makoto Shinkai and starring Kotaro Daigo, Nana Mori, and Tsubasa Honda. The film follows a runaway teen who arrives in a perpetually rainy Tokyo and befriends an orphaned girl with the supernatural ability to clear the skies; their growing romance and small business offering sunshine draw moral dilemmas and escalating consequences. Visually sumptuous and richly textured, the movie juxtaposes intimate character drama with grand, rain-drenched spectacle while exploring themes of love, sacrifi...

short_descriptions.value: A runaway teen in rain-soaked Tokyo befriends an orphan girl who can clear the skies, and their risky romance forces them to confront fate, responsibility, and sacrifice.
Ein weggelaufener Teenager in einem regendurchtränkten Tokio trifft ein Waisenkind, das den Himmel klären kann; ihre riskante Beziehung stellt sie vor Schicksal, Verantwortung und Opfer.
Un adolescente fugado en un Tokio empapado conoce a una huérfana que puede hacer brillar el sol, y su arriesgada relación les obliga a afrontar destino, responsabilidad y sacrificio.
Un adolescent fugueur arrive dans un Tokyo sans cesse arrosé et rencontre une orpheline capable d'apaiser le ciel; leur romance risquée les confronte au destin et au sacrifice.

properties.description: Theater (2020), directed by Isao Yukisada and starring Kento Yamazaki, Mayu Matsuoka, and Kan'ichirô Satô, is a Japanese-language drama-romance about a theater troupe director whose financial and personal failures strain his relationships and artistic ambitions. The film traces his swings between grand ambition and crippling insecurity, the emotional harm inflicted on those around him, and the fragile hope that remains. Visually restrained and naturalistic, the movie emphasizes intimate performances and the moral complexity of its characters. Its themes include artistic struggle, the costs ...

short_descriptions.value: A struggling theatre director battles insecurity and ego as his failing troupe and fraught love life force him to confront the consequences of his ambition.
Ein kämpfender Theaterregisseur ringt mit Unsicherheit und Ego, während seine Truppe und Beziehung zerbrechen und er sich den Folgen seiner Ambitionen stellen muss.
Un director de teatro en apuros lidia con inseguridad y ego mientras su troupe y su relación se resquebrajan, obligándole a enfrentar las consecuencias de su ambición.
Un metteur en scène en difficulté lutte avec son ego et son manque de confiance alors que sa troupe et sa relation se détériorent, l'obligeant à affronter les conséquences de son ambition.

akas.value: "Ride Your Wave: Juntos en el mar"

properties.description: Ride Your Wave is a 2019 Japanese animated film directed by Masaaki Yuasa and featuring Ryôta Katayose, Rina Kawaei, and Honoka Matsumoto. Blending romance, comedy, drama, family-friendly moments, and light fantasy, it follows a surfer and a firefighter who fall in love and then face a devastating loss. The movie uses vivid, stylized animation and music to trace the heroine's grieving and healing, exploring themes of love, memory, and coping. Its tone is bittersweet and emotionally resonant, balancing heartwarming intimacy with heartrending tragedy.

short_descriptions.value: A surfer and a firefighter fall in love, then face a tragic separation that forces her to cope with loss while holding onto shared memories.
Eine Surferin und ein Feuerwehrmann verlieben sich; nach einer Tragödie muss sie mit dem Verlust umgehen und an ihren gemeinsamen Erinnerungen festhalten.
Una surfista y un bombero se enamoran; tras una tragedia ella debe afrontar la pérdida mientras se aferra a sus recuerdos compartidos.
Une surfeuse et un pompier tombent amoureux; après une tragédie, elle doit affronter la perte en s'accrochant à leurs souvenirs communs.

properties.description: The Last 10 Years (2022), directed by Michihito Fujii and starring Nana Komatsu, Kentarô Sakaguchi, and Yuki Yamada, is a Japanese romantic drama about a young woman diagnosed with a terminal illness who vows not to fall in love. When she reconnects with a former classmate at a reunion, the film follows their tentative, emotionally charged relationship as it navigates longing, fear, and the bittersweet urgency of limited time. With a melancholic tone, careful cinematography, and a prominent soundtrack, the story foregrounds themes of mortality, grief, acceptance, and the value of ordinary m...

short_descriptions.value: A young woman given ten years to live avoids romance, but a reunion with an old classmate forces her to confront love, mortality, and the value of everyday moments.
Eine junge Frau mit nur zehn Jahren zu leben vermeidet Liebe, doch ein Klassentreffen konfrontiert sie mit Liebe, Sterblichkeit und dem Wert des Alltags.
Una joven con solo diez años de vida evita enamorarse, pero una reunión con un antiguo compañero la enfrenta al amor, la mortalidad y el valor de lo cotidiano.
Une jeune femme qui n'a que dix ans à vivre évite l'amour, mais une réunion avec un ancien camarade la confronte à l'amour, la mortalité et à l'importance du quotidien.

properties.description: A Whisker Away (2020), directed by Junichi Sato and Tomotaka Shibayama and produced by Studio Colorido, is an animated fantasy romance that follows a shy schoolgirl who uses a magical mask to transform into a cat to get closer to her crush. Featuring voices by Mirai Shida, Natsuki Hanae, and Minako Kotobuki, the film balances whimsical fantasy with intimate coming-of-age drama as it examines identity, family tensions, and the consequences of hiding one’s true self. The emotional, melodic score and richly textured visuals reinforce a bittersweet yet ultimately hopeful tone.

short_descriptions.value: A shy girl uses a magical mask to become a cat and get close to her crush, but the line between her human self and the feline identity blurs with emotional consequences.
Ein schüchternes Mädchen trägt eine magische Maske, um sich in eine Katze zu verwandeln und ihrem Schwarm näherzukommen, doch die Grenze zwischen Mensch und Tier verwischt mit emotionalen Folgen.
Una chica tímida usa una máscara mágica para convertirse en gato y acercarse a su amor, pero la frontera entre su yo humano y el gato se difumina con consecuencias emocionales.
Une adolescente timide porte un masque magique pour devenir chat et se rapprocher de son amour, mais la frontière entre son identité humaine et féline s’estompe avec des répercussions émotionnelles.

properties.description: Aristocrats (2021), directed by Yukiko Sode and starring Mugi Kadowaki, Kiko Mizuhara, and Kei Ishibashi, is a Japanese drama that follows two young women from different social backgrounds. One woman seeks stability after a breakup while the other has climbed through study and work; their lives intersect and reveal tensions of class, family expectation, and gendered social roles. Shot in color with measured, lyrical cinematography, the film favors a slow-burn, character-driven approach that emphasizes quiet moments and social nuance. Its emotional register is observant and melancholic, expl...

short_descriptions.value: Two young women from different classes form a tentative friendship as they face romance, family pressure, and the limits of social mobility.
Zwei junge Frauen aus unterschiedlichen Klassen schließen eine zaghafte Freundschaft, während sie Liebe, familiären Druck und Grenzen sozialer Mobilität erleben.
Dos jóvenes de clases distintas forjan una amistad mientras lidian con el amor, la presión familiar y los límites de la movilidad social.
Deux jeunes femmes de milieux différents nouent une amitié fragile en affrontant l'amour, la pression familiale et les limites de la mobilité sociale.

properties.description: Last Letter (2020), directed by Shunji Iwai and starring Hideaki Anno, Masaharu Fukuyama and Suzu Hirose, is a romantic drama from Japan that centers on family ties, lost love and the consequences of ambiguous correspondence. Set against a funeral and its aftermath, the film follows a woman who reunites with her grown niece while attempting to notify the deceased's acquaintances, and an old flame whose messages reopen old wounds. Through overlapping past and present imagery and epistolary exchanges, the story probes grief, memory and mistaken identity in quiet, moving scenes. The result is ...

short_descriptions.value: At a funeral, a woman reconnects with her grown niece while a mistaken correspondence with an old flame blurs past and present.
Bei einer Beerdigung trifft eine Frau ihre inzwischen erwachsene Nichte wieder, während ein Briefwechsel mit einer alten Liebe Vergangenheit und Gegenwart verwischt.
En un funeral, una mujer se reencuentra con su sobrina ya adulta mientras una correspondencia con un antiguo amor difumina pasado y presente.
Lors d’un enterrement, une femme retrouve sa nièce adulte tandis qu’une correspondance avec un ancien amour brouille passé et présent.

entities.name: The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House

akas.value: "舞妓さんちのまかないさん"
"The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House"

properties.description: The Makanai: Cooking for the Maiko House (2023) is a Japanese web comedy-drama starring Nana Mori, Natsuki Deguchi, and Ai Hashimoto that follows two young women who move to Kyoto to train as maiko and the domestic world they inhabit. Rather than relying on plot twists, the series focuses on quiet, character-driven vignettes—training, mentorship, and the meals prepared by the house's makanai—to explore tradition, identity, and friendship. Visually rich and gently paced, the show celebrates food, cultural ritual, and everyday intimacy to produce a soothing, emotionally resonant experience.

short_descriptions.value: Two friends move to Kyoto to train as maiko but take different paths while sharing life, work, and food in a maiko house.
Zwei Freundinnen ziehen nach Kyoto, um Maiko zu werden, doch gehen unterschiedliche Wege, während sie Leben und Küche in einem Maiko-Haus teilen.
Dos amigas se mudan a Kioto para formarse como maiko, pero toman caminos distintos mientras comparten vida y comida en la casa de maiko.
Deux amies viennent à Kyoto pour devenir maiko, mais suivent des voies différentes tout en partageant la vie et la cuisine d'une maison de maiko.

properties.description: Aggretsuko (2018) centers on a 25-year-old red panda office worker who copes with a thankless corporate job by unleashing death‑metal karaoke after hours. Featuring Sanrio character designs and a mix of comedy, drama, and musical interludes, the series balances workplace satire with character-driven emotional arcs. Main cast credits listed include Kaolip, Shingo Kato, and Rareko, and the show repeatedly addresses themes such as workplace stress, sexism, mental health, friendship, and self‑expression. Its emotional register shifts between cathartic rage and bittersweet empathy while remainin...

short_descriptions.value: A 25-year-old red panda office worker vents workplace frustration by singing death-metal karaoke after work.
Eine 25-jährige rote Panda-Büroangestellte baut ihren Frust durch Death‑Metal-Karaoke nach der Arbeit ab.
Una panda roja de 25 años, agobiada por su trabajo de oficina, libera su frustración cantando death metal en el karaoke.
Une panda rouge de 25 ans, épuisée par son travail de bureau, évacue sa frustration en chantant du death metal au karaoké.

entities.name: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke

properties.description: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke (2023) is a live-action adaptation of the beloved shojo property that stars Kou Aoki, Sara Minami, and Oji Suzuka in a gentle romantic comedy-drama. The story centers on a shy, misunderstood high-school girl whose life changes when an outgoing classmate befriends her, leading to new friendships and first love. Across its episodes the show emphasizes character-driven, coming-of-age themes—identity, social acceptance, and emotional growth—delivered with a sentimental, nostalgic tone and visually polished direction.

short_descriptions.value: A shy, misunderstood teen opens up when a kind classmate reaches out, leading to friendship and her first love.
Ein schüchternes, missverstandenes Mädchen öffnet sich, als ein freundlicher Mitschüler auf sie zugeht, was Freundschaft und erste Liebe entstehen lässt.
Una chica tímida y malentendida sale de su caparazón cuando un compañero amable se acerca, dando paso a la amistad y al primer amor.
Une adolescente timide et incomprise s’ouvre peu à peu grâce à un camarade bienveillant, et découvre l’amitié puis son premier amour.

properties.description: Gintama (2005) is a long-running Japanese animated series based on Hideaki Sorachi’s manga, produced by Sunrise and directed in early seasons by Shinji Takamatsu (with Yoichi Fujita and others directing later installments). Starring voice actors Tomokazu Sugita, Daisuke Sakaguchi, and Rie Kugimiya among its principal cast, the show combines science-fiction and samurai tropes: Edo-era Japan is occupied by alien beings, and the story follows a lazy but skilled samurai who runs a small odd-jobs business and his eccentric partners. Equal parts slapstick comedy, pop-culture parody, action, and u...

short_descriptions.value: In an alternate-feudal Tokyo occupied by aliens, an unemployed samurai takes odd jobs with his quirky team, blending slapstick comedy, action, parody, and occasional sincere drama.
In einem von Außerirdischen besetzten feudalen Tokio nimmt ein arbeitsloser Samurai Aufträge mit seinem skurrilen Team an und mixt Komödie, Action, Parodie und Gefühl.
En un Tokio feudal ocupado por extraterrestres, un samurái desempleado acepta encargos con su peculiar equipo, mezclando comedia slapstick, acción, parodia y momentos emotivos.
Dans un Tokyo féodal occupé par des extraterrestres, un samouraï sans emploi accepte des petits boulots avec son équipe décalée, mêlant comédie, action et émotion.

properties.description: Spy x Family (2022) is an animated action-comedy series that follows a master spy who creates a fake family as part of a cover; the household unexpectedly includes an assassin wife and a telepathic child. The show balances dynamic espionage set-pieces with slice-of-life family comedy, exploring themes of secrecy, identity, and belonging while maintaining a warm, humorous tone. Voice performers listed include Takuya Eguchi, Atsumi Tanezaki, and Alex Organ. Its blend of character-driven warmth and action-oriented pacing gives it broad appeal across family-friendly and anime-focused audiences.

short_descriptions.value: A spy, an assassin, and a telepathic child pose as a family to conceal their secrets while juggling missions, school, and unexpectedly growing affection.
Ein Spion, eine Attentäterin und ein telepathisches Kind geben eine falsche Familie, um ihre Geheimnisse zu verbergen, und meistern Missionen, Schule und wachsende Zuneigung.
Un espía, una asesina y una niña telepática forman una familia falsa para ocultar sus secretos mientras enfrentan misiones, el colegio y el cariño que surge entre ellos.
Un espion, une tueuse à gages et une enfant télépathe forment une famille factice pour cacher leurs secrets tout en gérant missions, école et l'affection naissante.

properties.description: Food Wars: Shokugeki no Soma is a competitive culinary anime that follows a talented young cook who enrolls in an elite culinary academy to refine his skills and outcook his father. Blending high-energy comedy, exaggerated visualizations of taste, and earnest depictions of technique, the series stages elaborate cook-offs—shokugeki—that serve as trials testing creativity, skill, and resolve. Rooted in themes of ambition, mentorship, tradition versus innovation, and the social power of food, the narrative evolves from classroom challenges to large-scale tournaments while maintaining a tone th...

short_descriptions.value: A young cook enrolls in an elite culinary academy where intense cooking duels push him to master his craft and surpass his father's skills.
Ein junger Koch tritt in eine Elite-Kochschule ein, wo intensive Kochduelle ihn treiben, sein Handwerk zu meistern und seinen Vater zu übertreffen.
Un joven cocinero entra en una prestigiosa academia culinaria donde duelos gastronómicos lo empujan a dominar su oficio y superar a su padre.
Un jeune cuisinier rejoint une académie culinaire d'élite où des duels gastronomiques le poussent à maîtriser son art et dépasser son père.

properties.description: Grand Blue Dreaming (2018) is a Japanese animated comedy-drama that follows a college freshman who moves to a seaside town and becomes entangled with a boisterous group of friends centered around a local diving club. The series stars voice actors Yuma Uchida, Ryohei Kimura, and Hiroki Yasumoto and combines slapstick, exaggerated facial gags, and rapid-cut comedy with quieter moments of friendship and self-discovery. Tonally it alternates between raucous, party-driven episodes and sincere coming-of-age beats, exploring college life, youthful freedom, and the bonds formed in messy, shared exp...

short_descriptions.value: A college freshman moves to a seaside town and is swept into a raucous group of friends, wild antics, and a diving club.
Ein College-Student zieht in eine Küstenstadt und gerät in den Strudel ausgelassener Freunde, wilder Streiche und eines Tauchclubs.
Un estudiante universitario se muda a un pueblo costero y se ve arrastrado por un grupo de amigos alocados, sus bromas y un club de buceo.
Un étudiant s'installe dans une ville côtière et se laisse entraîner par un groupe d'amis délirants, leurs frasques et un club de plongée.

tags.name: Chainsaw as instrument of violence and renewal

properties.description: Chainsaw Man (2022) is an adult-oriented animated adaptation of a popular manga that blends dark fantasy, brutal action, and black comedy. Produced by MAPPA and based on the manga by Tatsuki Fujimoto, the series follows a desperate young man who is resurrected when his pet devil fuses with him, turning him into a chainsaw-wielding devil-human hybrid. Recruited into a government-aligned devil-hunting agency, he partners with other misfit hunters and becomes entangled with a manipulative superior while confronting grotesque devils and moral compromises. The show is notable for its stark contr...

short_descriptions.value: A betrayed young man fuses with his pet devil to become a chainsaw-powered hybrid and joins a devil-hunting agency, confronting violence, manipulation, and his own desires.
Nach einem Verrat verschmilzt ein junger Mann mit seinem Haustier-Teufel und wird zum Kettensägen-Hybrid, der sich einer Teufelsjäger-Organisation anschließt.
Tras una traición, un joven se fusiona con su diablo mascota y se convierte en un híbrido motosierrado; se une a cazadores de demonios y afronta violencia y manipulación.
Après une trahison, un jeune homme fusionne avec son démon domestique et devient un hybride scie-mécanique, puis rejoint des chasseurs de démons entre violence et manipulation.

properties.description: Tomo-chan Is a Girl! (2023) is an animated romantic-comedy drama that follows a tomboyish high-school girl who has long been in love with her childhood friend but is seen only as "one of the guys." Starring Rie Takahashi, Kaito Ishikawa, and Rina Hidaka, the series adapts a gag-driven four-panel comic style into an episodic anime that balances broad physical humor with sincere character development. Over its run it explores themes of friendship, identity, and the awkward, slow-burning transition from friends to lovers, delivered with warm, uplifting emotional beats.

short_descriptions.value: A tomboy high-schooler confesses to her childhood friend and spends the series trying to get him to see her as more than a friend while navigating identity and friendship.
Eine tomboyhafte Gymnasiastin gesteht ihrem Freund aus Kindertagen und versucht, ihn dazu zu bringen, sie als mehr als eine Freundin zu sehen, während sie Freundschaft und Identität erkundet.
Una chica tomboy de instituto confiesa a su amigo de la infancia y pasa la serie intentando que la vea como algo más que una amiga mientras explora la amistad y su identidad.
Une lycéenne tomboy avoue ses sentiments à son ami d'enfance et tente durant la série de lui faire voir en elle plus qu'une amie, tout en explorant amitié et identité.

properties.description: Mob Psycho 100 is an animated series based on the manga by ONE and produced by studio Bones, directed by Yuzuru Tachikawa, with music contributions credited to MOB CHOIR. The show follows a shy middle-schooler with growing psychic powers who tries to live a normal life while working odd jobs under an unlikely mentor and confronting supernatural threats. Blending action, comedy, and slice-of-life drama, it foregrounds character development, emotional themes like anxiety and belonging, and a deconstruction of shonen hero tropes. The series is praised for its striking, distinctive animation, k...

short_descriptions.value: A shy middle-school psychic struggles to live a normal life while learning to control his growing powers and emotions.
Ein schüchterner Schüler mit psychischen Kräften versucht, ein normales Leben zu führen und seine Kräfte sowie Gefühle zu kontrollieren.
Un tímido estudiante de secundaria con poderes psíquicos intenta llevar una vida normal mientras controla sus poderes y emociones.
Un collégien timide doté de pouvoirs psychiques tente de mener une vie normale tout en maîtrisant ses pouvoirs et ses émotions.

akas.value: "Yahari ore no seishun love kome wa machigatteiru"
"やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。"

properties.description: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU (original Japanese title Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru) is a 2013 animated drama/romantic comedy adapted from Wataru Watari's light novels. The first season, directed by Ai Yoshimura and produced as a TV anime, follows an acerbic, isolated high-school student compelled to join his school's Volunteer Service Club alongside two classmates. The series mixes pointed, often humorous dialogue with quieter, melancholic character work as the trio solves peers' social problems and — in the process — confronts their own emotional defenses. Themes inc...

short_descriptions.value: A cynical, solitary high-schooler is forced into a volunteer club where solving classmates' problems forces him to confront isolation, honesty, and complicated feelings.
Ein zynischer, zurückgezogener Gymnasiast tritt einem Freiwilligenclub bei und muss beim Lösen von Mitschülerproblemen seine Isolation und Gefühle hinterfragen.
Un estudiante solitario y cínico se ve obligado a entrar en un club de voluntariado; al resolver los problemas de sus compañeros, afronta su aislamiento y sentimientos complejos.
Un lycéen cynique et solitaire rejoint un club bénévole ; en aidant ses camarades, il confronte son isolement, la sincérité et des sentiments compliqués.

entities.name: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

akas.value: "この素晴らしい世界に祝福を！"
"Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!"

properties.description: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! is a 2016 anime adaptation of Natsume Akatsuki's light novel, directed by Takaomi Kanasaki and produced by Studio Deen. Starring Jun Fukushima, Sora Amamiya, Rie Takahashi, and Ai Kayano, the series blends comedy, fantasy, and adventure to subvert typical isekai and RPG conventions. After a young man dies and is offered rebirth in a magical realm by a self-described goddess, he forms a disastrously inept adventuring party and endures a string of absurd, episodic misadventures. The show emphasizes broad slapstick, satirical takes on heroism a...

short_descriptions.value: A dead otaku is reincarnated in a fantasy world and joins a hapless adventuring party, leading to absurd misadventures that parody RPG and isekai tropes.
Ein wiedergeborener Otaku bildet in einer Fantasywelt eine Pannen-Truppe mit einer nutzlosen Göttin und zwei exzentrischen Gefährtinnen und erlebt komische Missgeschicke.
Un otaku reencarnado en un mundo fantástico forma un grupo con una inútil diosa y dos excéntricas, provocando desventuras cómicas que parodian los tropos RPG.
Un otaku réincarné dans un monde fantastique forme une équipe maladroite avec une déesse inutile et deux compagnes excentriques, entraînant des mésaventures comiques.

properties.description: Natsuki isn't like the other girls. She has a wand and a transformation mirror. She might be a witch, or an alien from another planet. Together with her cousin Yuu, Natsuki spends her summers in the wild mountains of Nagano, dreaming of other worlds. When a terrible sequence of events threatens to part the two children forever, they make a promise: survive, no matter what.   Now Natsuki is grown. She lives a quiet life with her asexual husband, surviving as best she can by pretending to be normal.
