short_descriptions.value: A couple struggles to keep their long-distance relationship alive as real-world pressures and unexpected choices test their bond.
Ein Paar kämpft darum, seine Fernbeziehung zu erhalten, während Alltagsdruck und unerwartete Entscheidungen ihre Bindung auf die Probe stellen.
Una pareja lucha por mantener su relación a distancia mientras las presiones reales y decisiones inesperadas ponen a prueba su vínculo.
Un couple peine à préserver sa relation à distance alors que les pressions du quotidien et des choix inattendus mettent leur lien à l'épreuve.

properties.description: 20th Century Girl (2022), directed by Bang Woo-ri and starring Kim Yoo-jung, Byeon Woo-seok and Park Jung-woo, is a romantic drama set in 1999 about a high school girl who watches a popular classmate as a favor to her ailing best friend. Through quiet observation and vivid, color-forward cinematography the film traces first love, friendship and the lasting sting of loss. Its nostalgic 90s aesthetic and intimate performances create a bittersweet, tearful mood that emphasizes memory and coming of age.

short_descriptions.value: In 1999, a kind-hearted teen spies on a popular classmate for her ailing friend and unexpectedly encounters first love, loss, and growing up.
1999 beobachtet ein gutherziges Mädchen einen beliebten Mitschüler für ihre kranke Freundin und erlebt unerwartet erste Liebe, Verlust und Erwachsenwerden.
En 1999, una chica bondadosa vigila a un compañero popular por su amiga enferma y descubre, inesperadamente, el primer amor, la pérdida y el crecer.
En 1999, une adolescente au grand cœur surveille un camarade populaire pour son amie malade et découvre l'amour, la perte et le passage à l'âge adulte.

properties.description: Soulmate (2023) is a South Korean romantic drama directed by Young-Keun Min and starring Kim Da-mi, Jeon So-nee, and Byeon Woo-seok. Over fourteen years, it follows two women who meet as children and whose relationship shifts between deep friendship and romance, unfolding through layered flashbacks and present-day encounters. The film is a character-driven, coming-of-age study that highlights memory, longing, and the small objects and places that anchor emotional lives. Its warm, lyrical visuals and evocative score give the story a melancholic, reflective tone.

short_descriptions.value: Two friends meet at eleven and, over fourteen years, navigate an evolving bond that moves between deep friendship and romance.
Zwei Freundinnen lernen sich mit elf kennen und entwickeln über vierzehn Jahre hinweg eine Beziehung zwischen tiefer Freundschaft und Liebe.
Dos amigas se conocen a los once años y, durante catorce años, su relación evoluciona entre amistad profunda y romance.
Deux amies se rencontrent à onze ans et, sur quatorze ans, leur lien évolue entre profonde amitié et amour.

properties.description: Inseparable Bros (2019), directed by Sang-Hyo Yook and starring Shin Ha-kyun, Lee Kwang-soo, and Esom, is a comedy-drama about two non-biological brothers whose complementary disabilities bind them in daily mutual care. One brother is intellectually sharp but quadriplegic, the other physically able with the mental age of a child, and together they navigate life after leaving an orphanage. The film balances humor and pathos while examining themes of abandonment, caregiving, social bureaucracy, and the struggle to maintain independence and dignity.

short_descriptions.value: Two non-blood brothers—one brilliant but wheelchair-bound, the other physically able with a childlike mind—rely on each other to navigate adulthood, family, and social challenges.
Zwei nicht blutsverwandte Brüder — einer brillant, ans Rollstuhl gebunden, der andere körperlich fähig mit kindlichem Gemüt — stützen sich durchs Erwachsenwerden, Familie und Gesellschaft.
Dos hermanos no biológicos — uno brillante pero en silla de ruedas y el otro físicamente capaz con mente infantil — se apoyan para afrontar la adultez, la familia y la sociedad.
Deux frères non biologiques — l'un brillant mais en fauteuil, l'autre physiquement apte mais à l'âme d'enfant — s'entraident pour affronter l'âge adulte, la famille et la société.

properties.description: Start-Up (2019), directed by Jeong-Yeol Choi, is a South Korean action-comedy-drama starring Ma Dong-seok, Park Jeong-min, and Jung Hae-in. It follows two young men coming of age as they struggle to find work, make money and navigate family and friendships while getting pulled into debt-collection and gangster conflicts. The film mixes broad comedy and physical action with tender, character-driven moments to explore financial struggle, regret, and the search for purpose. Its tone alternates between laugh-out-loud sequences and gritty, moving scenes.

short_descriptions.value: Two young men navigate friendship, work and family while confronting debt and gangster entanglements on their path to adulthood.
Zwei junge Männer kämpfen mit Arbeit, Familie und Schulden und geraten in Konflikte mit Gangstern, während sie erwachsen werden.
Dos jóvenes lidian con la amistad, el trabajo y la familia mientras enfrentan deudas y problemas con gánsteres en su camino a la madurez.
Deux jeunes hommes affrontent travail, dettes et gangsters tout en apprenant à devenir adultes.

properties.description: Kim Ji-young: Born 1982 (2019), directed by Kim Do-Young and starring Jung Yu-mi, Gong Yoo, and Kim Mi-kyung, is a South Korean drama adapted from a bestselling novel. The story follows a thirty-something woman who, after leaving the workforce to raise her child, begins to dissociate and speak with the voices of other women in her life, revealing the cumulative effects of everyday sexism. Through quiet, domestic vignettes and memory flashes, the film explores themes of motherhood, invisible labor, identity, and mental health with a restrained, empathetic tone. Its intimate, realist style em...

short_descriptions.value: A Korean woman in her 30s begins dissociating and speaking in the voices of other women as everyday sexism and domestic pressures erode her sense of self.
Eine koreanische Frau in den Dreißigern beginnt sich zu dissoziieren und in den Stimmen anderer Frauen zu sprechen, während alltäglicher Sexismus und häusliche Belastungen ihre Identität untergraben.
Una mujer coreana de treinta y tantos empieza a disociarse y a hablar con las voces de otras mujeres mientras el sexismo cotidiano y las cargas domésticas minan su identidad.
Une femme coréenne dans la trentaine commence à se dissocier et à parler avec les voix d’autres femmes alors que le sexisme quotidien et les charges domestiques érodent son identité.

properties.description: Cheer Up, Mr. Lee (2019), directed by Kae-Byeok Lee and starring Cha Seung-won, Um Chae-young and Park Hae-joon, is a comedy-drama and family film about an intellectually challenged man whose life changes when a sick young girl claiming to be his daughter appears. The pair leave the hospital and set off on a road trip that unfolds with gentle humor, tender moments and emotional revelations. The film centers on themes of family, caregiving, illness and reconciliation, delivering a warm, bittersweet tone that emphasizes character and empathy.

short_descriptions.value: A kind but slow-witted man reunites with a sick girl who claims to be his daughter, and they set off on a poignant, often funny road trip together.
Ein gutherziger, geistig langsamer Mann trifft ein krankes Mädchen, das behauptet, seine Tochter zu sein, und sie brechen gemeinsam zu einer bewegenden, teils humorvollen Reise auf.
Un hombre amable pero con discapacidad intelectual se reencuentra con una niña enferma que dice ser su hija y emprenden juntos un emotivo y a veces divertido viaje por carretera.
Un homme bon mais un peu simple retrouve une fillette malade qui prétend être sa fille ; ils partent ensemble pour un voyage routier à la fois touchant et souvent drôle.

properties.description: Keys to the Heart (2018), directed by Sung-Hyun Choi and starring Lee Byung-hun, Park Jeong-min, and Han Ji-min, is a comedy-drama about a washed-up boxer who reunites with his estranged younger brother, a gifted pianist with savant syndrome. The film uses music and performance as emotional anchors while exploring themes of family estrangement, grief, and forgiveness. Tonally it mixes gentle comedy with tearful, heartfelt scenes, supported by strong lead performances and a memorable soundtrack. Overall, it’s a sentimental family drama about healing through connection.

short_descriptions.value: A washed-up boxer reunites with his estranged brother, a piano savant, as music and grief push the family toward forgiveness and unexpected connection.
Ein gescheiterter Boxer trifft seinen entfremdeten Bruder, einen Pianisten mit Savant-Syndrom, und Musik sowie Trauer führen sie zu Vergebung und unerwarteter Verbundenheit.
Un boxeador venido a menos se reúne con su hermano distanciado, un pianista savant, y la música y el duelo los acercan hacia el perdón y lazos inesperados.
Un boxeur déchu retrouve son frère éloigné, un pianiste savant, et la musique ainsi que le deuil les poussent vers le pardon et des liens inattendus.

properties.description: Ditto (2022), directed by Eun-young Seo and starring Yeo Jin-goo, Cho Yi-hyun, and Kim Hye-yoon, is a romantic drama with fantasy and sci‑fi overtones. The film follows a college student in 1999 who unexpectedly connects by ham radio with a woman living in 2022, and their cross‑temporal conversations lead to quiet, often bittersweet reckonings about love and choice. Rooted in nostalgia and character-driven emotion, the story examines fate, missed opportunities, and the intergenerational ties that shape healing. The tone is tender and reflective, balancing warmth with melancholy.

short_descriptions.value: A 1999 college student and a woman in 2022 connect via a mysterious radio link and share love stories across time.
Ein Student von 1999 und eine Frau von 2022 verbinden sich über ein mysteriöses Funkgerät und teilen ihre Liebesgeschichten über die Zeit hinweg.
Un estudiante de 1999 y una joven de 2022 se conectan por una radio misteriosa y comparten sus historias de amor a través del tiempo.
Un étudiant de 1999 et une jeune femme de 2022 se relient par une radio mystérieuse et partagent leurs histoires d'amour à travers le temps.

properties.description: Swing Kids (2018), directed by Kang Hyeong-cheol, is a drama-musical set during the Korean War that features an ensemble cast including Oh Jung-se, Lee Da-wit, A.J. Simmons, Doh Kyungsoo, Jared Grimes and Park Hye-soo. The plot follows a North Korean tap dancer imprisoned at Geoje camp who becomes part of a multi-national troupe assembled to stage a publicity show, forcing inmates from opposing sides to confront ideology and form unexpected bonds. The film blends energetic tap choreography and period production design with themes of camaraderie, identity, and redemption, delivering a bitter...

short_descriptions.value: A North Korean tap dancer in a Korean War POW camp joins a diverse troupe whose performances bridge ideological divides through music and dance.
Ein nordkoreanischer Stepptänzer in einem Kriegsgefangenenlager des Koreakriegs schließt sich einer Tanzgruppe an, die Feinde durch Musik und Auftritte verbindet.
Un bailarín norcoreano de claqué en un campo de prisioneros de la Guerra de Corea se une a una troupe diversa que acerca a enemigos mediante la música y la danza.
Un danseur nord-coréen de claquettes dans un camp de prisonniers de la guerre de Corée rejoint une troupe qui rapproche ennemis grâce à la musique et la danse.

properties.description: Hospital Playlist (2020) is a South Korean ensemble medical drama directed by Shin Won-ho and written by Lee Woo-jung, starring Jo Jung-suk, Yoo Yeon-seok, Jung Kyung-ho, Kim Dae-myung, and Jeon Mi-do. The series follows five doctors who have been friends since medical school as they treat patients, face professional and ethical dilemmas, and manage their personal and romantic lives while sharing a close off-duty bond that includes playing together in a band. Tonally the show is warm, humane, and quietly humorous, leaning into slice-of-life storytelling to explore themes of friendship, mort...

short_descriptions.value: Five longtime friends who are doctors balance hospital work, personal lives, and a shared band, blending humor and heartfelt, slice-of-life stories.
Fünf befreundete Ärzte vereinen Klinikalltag, Privatleben und eine gemeinsame Band zu warmherzigen, humorvollen Episoden des Alltags.
Cinco amigos médicos compaginan el trabajo en el hospital, sus vidas personales y una banda común, combinando humor y conmovedoras historias cotidianas.
Cinq amis médecins concilient travail à l'hôpital, vies personnelles et un groupe de musique, mêlant humour et récits touchants du quotidien.

properties.description: Something in the Rain (2018), directed by Ahn Pan-seok and starring Son Ye-jin and Jung Hae-in, is a romantic drama that tells the slow-burning love story between a 35-year-old coffeehouse supervisor and a 29-year-old animator. The series blends intimate, everyday moments with realistic depictions of workplace tensions and social scrutiny, especially regarding age-different relationships in contemporary South Korea. Through understated performances and a cinematic, emotionally resonant visual style, it explores themes of desire, vulnerability, family expectations, and gendered power dynamic...

short_descriptions.value: A single career woman reconnects with her best friend's younger brother, leading to a blossoming romance after years apart.

properties.description: Still 17 (2018) is a South Korean romantic comedy-drama starring Shin Hye-sun, Yang Se-jong, and Ahn Hyo-seop that follows a teenage-minded woman who wakes from a thirteen-year coma and must navigate adult life. The series mixes lighthearted humor and romantic beats with melodramatic questions of guilt, memory, and healing. Through tender performances and time-jumping flashbacks, it foregrounds character growth, family reconnection, and second chances. The tone balances heartwarming, bittersweet emotion with playful, quirky moments.

short_descriptions.value: After waking from a thirteen-year coma, a woman struggles to adjust to adult life and reconnect with the man she believes caused the accident.
Nach einem dreizehnjährigen Koma kämpft eine Frau darum, sich ins Erwachsenenleben einzugliedern und den Mann zu finden, den sie für den Unfall verantwortlich hält.
Tras despertar de un coma de trece años, una mujer lucha por adaptarse a la vida adulta y reencontrarse con el hombre a quien culpa del accidente.
Après treize ans de coma, une femme tente de s'adapter à la vie d'adulte et de retrouver l'homme qu'elle tient pour responsable de l'accident.

properties.description: Melloga Chejil (released 2019) is a South Korean romantic comedy series that follows three thirty-year-old best friends living and working in Seoul's entertainment industry. Starring Chun Woo-hee, Jeon Yeo-been and Han Ji-eun, the show blends witty, literate dialogue with emotionally honest storytelling as its characters confront career challenges, romantic entanglements and personal loss. Praised for its ensemble performances and balanced tone, the series emphasizes friendship, professional ambition and the process of healing with warmth and subtle humor.

short_descriptions.value: Three thirty-something best friends navigate careers, love and grief in Seoul's entertainment industry with warmth and humor.
Drei Frauen in den Dreißigern meisterten Karriere, Liebe und Trauer in Seouls Unterhaltungsbranche mit Humor und berührender Wärme.
Tres amigas de treinta años navegan carrera, amor y duelo en la industria del entretenimiento de Seúl con humor y calidez.

properties.description: Clean with Passion for Now (2018) is a South Korean romantic comedy‑drama starring Yoon Kyun‑sang, Kim Yoo‑jung, and Song Jae‑rim. The series follows the messy cleaning‑company employee Gil Oh Sol and her relationship with the germ‑fearing company boss Jang Sun Gyeol as their clashing habits lead to romance. Alongside its rom‑com beats, the show treats mysophobia and emotional vulnerability with sensitivity while exploring family ties and personal growth. Its tone combines lighthearted humor with heartfelt, character‑driven moments and a memorable soundtrack.

short_descriptions.value: A germ‑obsessed company boss meets a messy cleaning employee and, through clashing habits, they fall in love as she helps him confront his mysophobia.
Ein von Sauberkeit besessener Chef trifft auf eine unordentliche Reinigungskraft; ihre gegensätzlichen Gewohnheiten führen zu einer Romanze, in der sie ihm hilft, seine Mysophobie zu überwinden.
Un jefe obsesionado con la limpieza conoce a una empleada desordenada; sus hábitos opuestos desatan un romance mientras ella le ayuda a enfrentar su misofobia.

properties.description: Run On is a 2020 South Korean romantic drama starring Yim Si-wan, Shin Sae-Kyeong, and Sooyoung Choi. The series follows a reserved national track athlete whose orderly life is upended when a spirited film translator enters his world, triggering slow-burning romance and personal growth across a cast of interrelated characters. Grounded in slice-of-life observation and sports elements, the story focuses on communication, family pressure, class differences, and emotional healing. Its tone is calm and tender, favoring subtle character development and warm, intimate visuals.

short_descriptions.value: A reserved national runner and a film translator form an unexpected bond that sparks emotional growth, healing, and a slow-burning romance.
Ein zurückhaltender Leichtathlet und eine Filmübersetzerin schließen eine unerwartete Verbindung, die emotionales Wachstum, Heilung und eine langsame Romanze fördert.
Un corredor nacional reservado y una traductora de cine forman un vínculo inesperado que impulsa crecimiento emocional, sanación y un romance de lento desarrollo.
Un coureur national réservé et une traductrice de films nouent un lien inattendu qui favorise la croissance émotionnelle, la guérison et une romance lente.

properties.description: Encounter is a 2018 South Korean romantic drama starring Song Hye-kyo, Park Bo-gum, and Jeon So-nee. It follows a reserved, affluent woman and a younger man who meet by chance and develop a relationship that challenges class boundaries and workplace dynamics. The series centers on mature, character-driven romance, family conflict, and themes of forgiveness and redemption, presented with polished, sunlit visuals and intimate scenes. Viewers describe it as heartfelt, restrained, and emotionally engaging.

short_descriptions.value: A reserved, wealthy woman and a younger man defy class and family pressures to pursue a tender, complicated romance.
Eine wohlhabende, zurückhaltende Frau und ein jüngerer Mann trotzen familiären und sozialen Zwängen, um eine zarte, komplizierte Romanze zu führen.
Una mujer adinerada y reservada y un hombre más joven desafían la familia y la clase social para vivir un romance tierno y complicado.
Une femme riche et réservée et un homme plus jeune défient les pressions familiales et sociales pour vivre une romance tendre et compliquée.

properties.description: Queen of Tears is a 2024 South Korean television series written by Park Ji-eun and directed by Kim Hee-won and Jang Young-woo. Starring Kim Soo-hyun, Kim Ji-won, and Park Sung-hoon, it follows a married couple whose relationship is pushed to the brink by family pressure, business tensions, and a devastating personal crisis. Blending comedy, drama, and romance, it is known for its emotional intensity, strong chemistry, and glossy production style.

short_descriptions.value: A troubled married couple faces family pressure, corporate intrigue, and emotional upheaval as they struggle to reconnect.
Ein Ehepaar in der Krise kämpft mit Familiendruck, Konzernintrigen und emotionalem Chaos, um wieder zueinanderzufinden.
Una pareja en crisis afronta presión familiar, intrigas empresariales y una gran sacudida emocional mientras intenta reencontrarse.
Un couple en crise affronte pression familiale, intrigues d’entreprise et bouleversements émotionnels pour se retrouver.

properties.description: Call It Love (2023) is a South Korean drama-romance starring Kim Young-kwang, Lee Sung-kyung, and Sung Jun. The series follows a woman who, after a life crisis, plots revenge but gradually comes to empathize with the person she blames, setting off a slow-burn romantic and emotional reckoning. Through intimate cinematography, carefully composed silence, and a poignant soundtrack, the show examines themes of revenge, forgiveness, family conflict, and healing. Tonally melancholic yet hopeful, it emphasizes character-driven transformation and subtle, powerful performances.

short_descriptions.value: A woman plans revenge after a personal crisis but slowly develops empathy and complicated love for the person she blames.
Nach einer Lebenskrise plant eine Frau Rache, entwickelt aber allmählich Empathie und eine komplizierte Liebe für ihr Ziel.
Una mujer planea venganza tras una crisis personal pero poco a poco empatiza y desarrolla un amor complicado por quien culpa.
Après une crise personnelle, une femme prépare sa vengeance mais finit par éprouver de l'empathie et un amour trouble envers sa cible.

properties.description: Itaewon Class (2020) is a South Korean drama series adapted from Jo Gwang-jin's popular webtoon and directed by Kim Sung-yoon. Starring Park Seo-joon, Kim Da-mi, Yoo Jae-myung, Kwon Nara, Ahn Bo-hyun, and Lee Joo-young, the series blends revenge-driven melodrama with romantic and business-story elements. It follows an ex-convict who opens a bar in Seoul's Itaewon neighborhood as part of a long-term plan to challenge a powerful food conglomerate responsible for his father's downfall. Over the course of the series, he gathers a disparate team of employees, navigates corporate sabotage, public...

short_descriptions.value: An ex-con opens a street bar and builds a diverse team to take down the powerful conglomerate that ruined his family while seeking justice and love.
Ein Ex-Häftling eröffnet eine Bar und formt ein diverses Team, um den Konzern zu stürzen, der seine Familie ruinierte, dabei sucht er Gerechtigkeit und Liebe.
Un exconvicto abre un bar en la calle y reúne un equipo diverso para derrotar al conglomerado que arruinó a su familia, buscando justicia y amor.
Un ex-détenu ouvre un bar de quartier et forme une équipe diverse pour affronter le conglomérat qui a détruit sa famille, cherchant justice et amour.

properties.description: Backstreet Rookie is a 2020 South Korean romantic comedy series starring Ji Chang-wook, Kim Yoo-jung and Han Sun-hwa. The story follows a former troublemaker who begins working at a neighborhood convenience store owned by a man who once helped her, unfolding into a workplace romcom that mixes physical humor, parody and heartfelt relationship drama. Episodes highlight family and friendship dynamics, second chances and personal growth, while visual callbacks to its webtoon origins and well-timed special effects give the series a distinctive, playful tone.

short_descriptions.value: A former troublemaker starts working at a convenience store run by the man who once helped her, triggering a playful romantic workplace comedy with heartfelt moments.
Eine frühere Unruhestifterin beginnt in einem Kiosk zu arbeiten, der dem Mann gehört, der ihr einst half, und erlebt eine verspielte, herzliche romantische Komödie.
Una antigua alborotadora encuentra trabajo en una tienda de conveniencia regentada por el hombre que la ayudó años atrás, desatando una comedia romántica juguetona y emotiva.
Une ancienne faiseuse de troubles travaille dans une supérette tenue par l'homme qui l'avait aidée autrefois, déclenchant une comédie romantique ludique et touchante.

properties.description: Her Private Life is a 2019 South Korean romantic comedy-drama that follows Sung Deok-mi, a museum curator who secretly lives as an obsessive fangirl, and Ryan Gold, the museum's new art director who becomes romantically involved with her. Starring Park Min-young and Kim Jae-wook alongside Ahn Bo-hyun, Park Jin-joo, Kim Bo-ra, and Jung Jae-won, the series mixes workplace romance, art-world settings, and fan-culture themes. The story balances light mystery and comedic moments with heartfelt character growth and emotional healing. Overall, it aims for a warm, swoonworthy tone anchored by stron...

short_descriptions.value: A museum curator secretly lives as an obsessive idol fangirl until her new art director discovers her double life and a slow-burning workplace romance unfolds.
Eine Museums-Kuratorin führt heimlich ein Leben als Idol-Fangirl, bis ihr neuer Kunstleiter ihr Doppelleben entdeckt und sich am Arbeitsplatz eine Romanze entfaltet.
Una conservadora de museo lleva una vida secreta como fangirl de un idol hasta que su nuevo director de arte descubre su doble vida y surge un romance en el trabajo.
Une conservatrice de musée mène une vie secrète de fangirl d’un idol jusqu’à ce que son nouveau directeur artistique découvre sa double vie et qu’une romance naisse au travail.

properties.description: On Your Wedding Day (2018), written and directed by Lee Seok-geun and starring Kim Young-kwang, Park Bo-young and Jeon Bae-soo, is a South Korean romantic dramedy that traces a couple’s relationship from high school into adulthood. Built around a wedding invitation that forces the protagonist to revisit his first love, the film mixes light comedy with poignant drama to examine timing, memory, and growth. Its tone is nostalgic and bittersweet, favoring realistic emotional beats and character development over melodramatic resolutions.

short_descriptions.value: A man receives a wedding invitation from his high-school first love and revisits their on-again, off-again relationship across years, confronting timing, growth, and letting go.

The film follows a tentative romance that grows between a young man and a physically disabled woman who lives largely inside her own imaginative world. Through restrained performances, evocative cinematography, and a measured pace, the story examines themes of disability, independence, and the tension between fantasy and reality, delivering a tender yet bittersweet emotional arc.

short_descriptions.value: A tender, bittersweet romance where a young man enters the inner world of a physically disabled woman, challenging both their ideas of love and independence.

Through quiet observation and vivid, color-forward cinematography the film traces first love, friendship and the lasting sting of loss. Its nostalgic 90s aesthetic and intimate performances create a bittersweet, tearful mood that emphasizes memory and coming of age.

properties.description: Soulmate (2023) is a South Korean romantic drama directed by Young-Keun Min and starring Kim Da-mi, Jeon So-nee, and Byeon Woo-seok. Over fourteen years, it follows two women who meet as children and whose relationship shifts between deep friendship and romance, unfolding through layered flashbacks and present-day encounters. The film is a character-driven, coming-of-age study that highlights memory, longing, and the small objects and places that anchor emotional lives. Its warm, lyrical visuals and evocative score give the story a melancholic, reflective tone.

The film follows a college student in 1999 who unexpectedly connects by ham radio with a woman living in 2022, and their cross‑temporal conversations lead to quiet, often bittersweet reckonings about love and choice. Rooted in nostalgia and character-driven emotion, the story examines fate, missed opportunities, and the intergenerational ties that shape healing. The tone is tender and reflective, balancing warmth with melancholy.

The film centers on themes of family, caregiving, illness and reconciliation, delivering a warm, bittersweet tone that emphasizes character and empathy.
